Why Choose Us for Family Dentistry?

html:
The Right Dentist For The Whole Family

Expert Dental Care In Kansas City

816-388-0985

Comprehensive Family Dentistry in Westport for All Ages

At Cosmetic and Implant Dentistry of Westport, we specialize in family dentistry that provides exceptional care for every member of your family—children, teens, adults, and seniors. Our goal is to make maintaining healthy smiles a convenient and enjoyable experience for the entire family.

Why Choose Us for Family Dentistry?

  • All-in-One Dental Care: From preventive treatments and regular check-ups to restorative and cosmetic services, we offer a full range of dental care under one roof.
  • Personalized Care Plans: Every smile is unique, which is why we create tailored treatment plans to meet the specific needs of each family member.
  • Preventive Focus: Our family dentistry services emphasize prevention through professional cleanings, thorough exams, and education on proper oral hygiene habits.
  • Comfortable, Stress-Free Environment: We strive to make every visit a positive experience, especially for children and those who feel anxious about dental appointments.

Family Dentistry Services We Offer:

  • Routine Check-ups and Cleanings
  • Fillings and Sealants
  • Restorative Dentistry for damaged or missing teeth
  • Cosmetic Treatments to enhance smiles
  • Education and Guidance for maintaining optimal oral health at home

At Cosmetic and Implant Dentistry of Westport, we’re dedicated to helping families in our community achieve and maintain beautiful, healthy smiles for life. Whether it’s your child’s first visit to the dentist, your teenager’s orthodontic consultation, or restorative care for a senior family member, we’re here to provide compassionate and expert.

816-388-0985

Dental Care Services

At Cosmetic and Implant Dentistry Westport, we offer comprehensive dental care tailored to meet your unique needs, from routine cleanings to advanced cosmetic and implant treatments. Trust us to provide you with the exceptional care and personalized attention you deserve—schedule your appointment today and experience the difference!

Wisdom Teeth

In-office procedures with IV sedation bring top care directly to you.

Implants

If you've lost one or more teeth, our dental implants can rebuild your smile.

Dentures

Bring back your confident smile and the look you've always wanted.

New Patient

Keep your teeth and gums healthy at our downtown Kansas City practice.

Clear Braces

Enjoy the benefits of straighter teeth without the bother of metal wires.

Dental Bridges

Fill in the gaps with custom dental appliances.

dental Insurance

Dr. Greaves is in network for United Healthcare, Aetna, Delta Dental, Metlife, Humana, and is in network with most medicare plans.

FAQs

What dental services do you offer?

CID Westport provides a wide range of dental services, including general dentistry, cosmetic procedures, emergency care, teeth cleaning, and dental implants. Their focus is on comprehensive oral health for all ages.

Do you handle dental emergencies?

Yes, they offer same-day services for emergencies such as severe pain, tooth trauma, or urgent dental issues. Their goal is to provide prompt relief and prevent further complications.

What should I expect during a teeth cleaning?

During a teeth cleaning, a dental hygienist removes plaque, tartar, and stains, followed by polishing your teeth. They also provide tips for maintaining oral health at home.

How often should I visit for routine check-ups?

It’s recommended to visit every six months for cleanings and exams to prevent issues like cavities and gum disease. Regular visits ensure early detection of any concerns.

What makes your practice different from others?

CID Westport emphasizes patient comfort, personalized care, and advanced dental technologies. They strive to build long-term relationships with patients through exceptional service.

Do you offer sedation options for anxious patients?

Yes, sedation dentistry options are available for patients with dental anxiety, helping them stay relaxed and comfortable throughout procedures.

Who are the doctors at CID Westport, and what are their qualifications?

CID Westport’s doctors are experienced professionals specializing in various fields of dentistry. They are dedicated to delivering high-quality care through expertise and compassion.
